name: Cameo
description: Cameo is a marketplace for purchasing personalized videos, messages, calls, and commercial promotional content from public figures and other talent. Individuals and businesses use it to submit creative requests, pay talent-defined prices, receive custom media, and license eligible content for approved uses.
agentUseSummary: Cameo cannot currently be connected through Relay. Cameo publishes interactive consumer and business booking flows rather than a third-party API contract, and each transaction combines payment, talent discretion, recipient data, endorsement terms, content rights, usage channels, and time-limited licensing that require explicit human and business authority.

blocked.label: Connect Cameo
blocked.description: Cameo publishes no self-service third-party application, authentication, authorization, endpoint, webhook, revocation, rate-limit, account-binding, or marketplace API contract for Relay.

blocked.label: Read Cameo catalog or account data
blocked.description: Automated talent search, availability, pricing, profiles, offerings, orders, briefs, messages, recipients, payments, fulfillment, media, licenses, reviews, rewards, and account data is unavailable.

blocked.label: Book or pay for offerings
blocked.description: Creating personal or business requests, selecting talent, accepting prices, entering instructions, supplying recipient data, purchasing messages or calls, booking videos, tipping, paying, cancelling, requesting refunds, and changing orders is blocked.

blocked.label: Arrange business endorsements
blocked.description: Creating briefs, negotiating budgets, buying Business Cameo videos, Paid Post Upsells, whitelisting, partnership or collaboration posts, talent posting, paid media, extensions, and written approvals is blocked.

blocked.label: Use Cameo content
blocked.description: Downloading, copying, editing, translating, combining, watermarking, sublicensing, publishing, boosting, distributing, advertising, archiving, deleting, or repurposing Cameo content is blocked without exact transaction-specific rights and approval.

blocked.label: Communicate through Cameo
blocked.description: Sending messages, briefs, requests, scripts, recipient details, reviews, support requests, talent responses, or other communications is blocked.

blocked.label: Expose credentials, payment, or identity data
blocked.description: Passwords, session cookies, social-login tokens, payment methods, billing details, identity-verification data, recipient contacts, private instructions, and private media never enter agent inputs or results.

blocked.label: Administer Cameo
blocked.description: Account, profile, talent, partner, team, payment, tax, rewards, referral, notification, privacy, social-link, identity, and business administration is blocked.

blocked.label: Use private Cameo interfaces
blocked.description: Browser automation, session replay, scraping, crawling, private or undocumented APIs, checkout automation, payment-form automation, content harvesting, reverse engineering, and raw exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable

providerSetup.blocker: Cameo publishes consumer and business marketplace, help, legal, and privacy surfaces but no self-service third-party developer application, authentication, authorization, endpoint, webhook, revocation, rate-limit, or exact-account contract. Cameo handles booking and payment within its platform. A request can disclose recipient and business information, create a paid obligation at a talent-defined or negotiated price, remain subject to talent discretion and fulfillment rules, and grant transaction-specific personal or commercial media rights with preparation periods, duration, channel, watermark, modification, sublicensing, endorsement, paid-post, and written-approval restrictions. Cameo also processes account, social-login, payment, identity, recipient, request, media, talent, message, and transaction data. Relay cannot invent browser or checkout automation, become the paying intermediary, or infer authority to contract for endorsements and content rights.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, partnerships, procurement, finance, legal, advertising, content, brand-safety, privacy, security, and customer owners must obtain Cameo's current written API, application, commercial, marketplace, payment, data-processing, and content-license contract. Freeze customer-owned payment authority and budgets; quote and fee acceptance; taxes, refunds and disputes; exact account and business binding; talent selection and conflicts; recipient consent and private instructions; fulfillment and rejection; personal versus business use; preparation and license periods; channels and territory; edits, watermarks, combinations, sublicensing and paid media; endorsement disclosures; Paid Post terms; download, retention and deletion; communications; audit; idempotency; and post-disconnect denial. Only then may Relay implement typed bounded wrappers and provider acceptance.

evidence.supports: Cameo for Business describes an on-platform flow in which Cameo handles talent booking and payment at talent-set prices and routes customers to a business specialist, without publishing a developer API.
Cameo documents signed-in website or app booking forms and distinguishes personal videos from commercial or promotional Business Cameo bookings.

Cameo's terms govern paid requests, talent discretion, refunds, personal and Business Cameo rights, preparation and license periods, approved channels, watermarks, edits, sublicensing, endorsements, and Paid Post arrangements.

Cameo's privacy policy covers account and social-login data, payment details, recipient contacts and request details, submissions, Talent Content, messages, purchases, identity verification, and order activity.
Cameo's community rules require users to respect intellectual-property, privacy, publicity, moral, and other legal rights when requesting or using content.
